home.headline: Hire on <mark>evidence</mark>, not claims.
home.lead: Credalent reads the work candidates have already done, scores it against the competencies you agreed, and shows what every score rests on. You interview fewer people, and you can defend each decision.
home.reassurance: No tests to sit. No automatic rejections. A person makes every hiring decision.

card.caption: {backed} backed by evidence · up to {upTo} if her open claim holds
card.upTo: up to {upTo} if her open claim holds

how.title: From job description to a decision you can defend

agree.title: Agree what matters
agree.body: Paste the job description. Credalent drafts five or six competencies with weights and the evidence that would prove each. Nothing is assessed until the hiring manager approves.

collect.title: Collect the work
collect.body: Repositories, test suites, design files, documents, shipped products. Where a candidate has nothing to show, Credalent asks for a short work sample and labels it as one.

rank.title: See why each person ranks where they do
rank.body: Every score cites its source and says how strong the evidence is. Claims are marked as claims, and count for nothing until something supports them.

interview.title: Interview only what is unproven
interview.body: Each interview gets questions tied to the gaps in that candidate’s evidence. Scorecards move the score, with the reason recorded.

decide.title: Decide with the pack in front of you
decide.body: Strengths, risks and open questions for each shortlisted candidate, on one page. Credalent recommends. You decide.

roleFamilies.title: Not only software engineers
roleFamilies.lead: AI is changing what good looks like in testing, data, operations, product, design and customer-facing engineering too. Each role family has its own kinds of proof, and Credalent knows which to look for.
roleFamilies.noPublicWork: No public work? Many testers, analysts and support specialists have none. Credalent requests a short work sample scoped to the role instead.
roleFamilies.more: This list is a start. We are piecing together more role families, and the one you hire for can be next.

trust.title: Recommendations you can check. Decisions that stay yours.

cites.title: Every score cites its source
cites.body: Open any assessment and see the exact commit, document or reference it rests on, and what it does not show.

claims.title: Claims are labelled as claims
claims.body: Nothing is called verified unless a second source confirms it. Candidate-submitted, corroborated and contradictory evidence look different.

human.title: Nobody is rejected automatically
human.body: Ranking orders your attention. Lower-ranked candidates stay visible, and thin evidence is treated as a gap to close.

numbers.title: Numbers say what they are
numbers.body: Observed, baseline or projection. If no hire has completed, the dashboard says so instead of showing a figure.

pilot.title: One number to judge us on: interviews per completed hire
pilot.body: Run a pilot on one role. It passes if you hold 30% fewer interviews per hire than your own baseline. You bring the baseline; Credalent shows the working.
